name: smwgraphics-stone-wall-ruin
title: Stone Wall Ruin
description:
From time to time you just need something interesting to add a bit of depth to a Level, using Layer 3. I pixelated these ruins for one of my hacks and they could be great for ghosthouses or catacombs.
Have fun with them, please give credits if you use them.

Please use it with Kevin's Ram Toggled Status Bar or any other patch / uberasm that removes the status bar.

Best Rudi
